purpose: Edit PDFs only with approved data processing and visual page verification.

trigger: Fix the specified title on page three of this PDF
Edit one sentence in a PDF using the nano-pdf CLI
Verify a generated PDF edit against the original
do_not_trigger: Upload a confidential contract without owner permission
Modify adjacent PDF pages by guessing indexing

preflight: Pin source PDF hash, exact page map and untouched backup.
Inspect CLI/provider/privacy behavior and ask consent for external document transfer.
Confirm destination file and forbid in-place destructive editing.
workflow: Prepare precise edit operation and verified target page.
Apply bounded edit only after required data-sharing consent.
Render changed page and neighbors, compare textual and visual artifacts.
Preserve original; report modified areas and output hash.

evidence.how_to_verify: Record source page count, selected page and immutable hash.
Owner approves exact external document transfer if the provider requires it.
Read back actual output PDF path, parseability and content hash.
Compare changed and neighboring pages against approved edit manifest.

failure_modes: Wrong-page edit requires restore, not blind page +1/-1 retry.
Never upload confidential PDFs by default or claim file size proves correctness.
